sharedRules.name: Scanning Systems
sharedRules.description: When this Ship uses its Detector special rule, you may place an additional two Spikes on a different enemy Group in line of sight.

sharedRules.name: Repair Bay
sharedRules.description:
Friendly Ships within 6" of this Ship that roll to repair Crippling Effects during the Repair step of the End Phase repair those effects on a roll of a 2+ instead of a 4+.
Friendly Ships that end their activation within 6" of this Ship on the same Orbital Layer recover 2 lost Hull Points.

sharedRules.name: Box Of Scraps
sharedRules.description: At the end of this ship's activation, pick one friendly ship within 6" in line of sight (including this one). Place a Box Of Scraps token next to that ship. The next time that ship would be destroyed, it isn't. Instead, before continuing to inflict damage, remove the Box of Scraps token and that ship remains in play with D3 Hull Points remaining, then continue inflicting damage as normal. Box Of Scraps tokens persist through rounds but a ship may only have 1 Box Of Scraps token.

sharedRules.name: SWACS
sharedRules.description: Enemy Ships within 12" of this ship may be targeted by friendly Ships firing Close Action weapons using the firing Ship's normal Weapon Range (Scan + Sig).

sharedRules.name: Wing Support
sharedRules.description: Friendly Fighters within 6" of this Ship can be used for Close Protection against any Kinetic weapons (in addition to Close Action and Bomber attacks). When friendly Fighters within 6" of this Ship are used to remove enemy Bombers, each Fighter removes 2 Bombers instead of 1. When friendly Bombers (of any type) within 6" of a Ship with this rule attack, they Saturation Fire when there are 5 or more Bombers in the attack instead of 6.

sharedRules.name: Debris Clearance
sharedRules.description: Once per game, this Ship may forgo any attacks it may make. If it does, instead of attacking, this Ship may replace a piece of Debris Field within 6" (measuring to the edge of that Debris Field) with a Micrometeor Cloud of approximately the same size in the same location, or remove a piece of Micrometeor Cloud within 6" from the table.

sharedRules.name: Space Telescope
sharedRules.description: This ship counts as having a single weapon for its Detector rule. When this ship uses its Detector rule, it may place an additional Spike on that Group, or it may place a Telescope token on that Group.

sharedRules.name: Telescope Token
sharedRules.description:
When you assign weapons to a Group that has a Telescope token, you may remove the token. If you do, one of the Group's Weapon Systems lowers the result required to score a critical against that Group by 1 for that attack (so a weapon that would crit on a 5+ crits on a 4+ instead).
Telescope tokens placed by this Ship persist between rounds and are only removed when this Ship would place another Telescope token or when a Ship with a Telescope token goes on the Silent Running order.

sharedRules.name: Explosive
sharedRules.description: When this ship is destroyed, it explodes with a range of 3" and rolls 1D3 on the Explosion Effect table.

sharedRules.name: Fire Ships
sharedRules.description: When this Load is shared with Bulk Landers, 2 Launch are needed to place 1 Fire Ship.

sharedRules.name: Feature Carrier-2
sharedRules.description: At the start of the game, before players deploy, choose two Deployable Features from the Resistance Deployable Features List (duplicates are allowed). This Ship starts the game carrying those Deployable Features.

sharedRules.name: Feature Carrier-1
sharedRules.description: At the start of the game, before players deploy, choose one Deployable Feature from the Resistance Deployable Features List. This Ship starts the game carrying that Deployable Feature.

sharedRules.name: Set Timers And Run
sharedRules.description: Once you complete an attack sequence with Explosive Detonation, remove this ship from the game. If there is a friendly Ship within 8" of this Ship, place a Fawkes' Crew Battalion on that Ship. This ship only counts for Ships killed when Fawkes' Crew Battalion is removed from the game.

sharedRules.name: Skeleton Crew
sharedRules.description: This Ship can only go on General Quarters.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Before you attack with a Group of M tonnage, pick two of its weapon systems with the same name without the Linked-X special rule. Those weapons gain Linked-SSN for that attack.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: When you activate a Group, all ships in that group gain Regenerate-2 until the end of the round.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: At the end of the round, remove 2D3 enemy Battalions from a friendly ship.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: When you launch Bulk Landers from this Ship or a Ship within 6" of it, you may have that Ship launch an additional 2 or 4 Bulk Landers. Any Ship that does takes that much damage (causing Crippling Effects and Explosions where applicable).

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: When you Overcharge a Group's weapon with "Vent" in its name, each Ship in the firing Group may Overcharge a second weapon this activation.

rules.name: Extensive Reactor Modifications
rules.description: If Hull points lost due to its Vent Cannon Batteries' Overcharge rule would cause this Ship to be destroyed, it rolls 3D3 for its explosion and that explosion also affects Ships in other Orbital Layers.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: When a friendly Ship of H or C tonnage would roll its Backup save due to an attack, improve its Backup save for that attack by 1.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: When you assign targets to a Weapon System with "Artillery" in its name, that Weapon System's damage type becomes Core for those attacks. If that Weapon System is on a H or C tonnage Ship this Ability costs 3AP.

rules.name: Spinal Mass Annihilator
rules.description: If damage from this weapon or any Crippling Effect it would cause would destroy a ship, remove that ship from the game without rolling for Explosion.

rules.name: VX Bomb
rules.description: This weapon gains the Scald-2 special rule when targeting Cities. If this weapon does damage to a City, remove all Battalions (friendly and enemy) from that City and any Features (including deployed Features) in the same City.

rules.name: Explosive Detonation
rules.description: When attacking with this weapon, skip the assign weapons to targets step and proceed to roll to hit instead. When rolling to hit with this weapon, for each result of a 6 (including rolls from this rule), roll an additional dice. After rolling to hit, assign hits as equally as possible to each other Ship and Space Station on the same Orbital Layer within 6" until no hits remain. Then continue the attack sequence as normal.

rules.name: ICBM Silo
rules.description:
Bombardment Torpedoes launched from this Feature can only attack Cities and cannot attack the Dropsite the launching Feature is deployed to.
Bombardment Torpedoes launched from this Feature become damage Type C when used against Cities at least 6" away from enemy Ships.
When an attacking Group or Asset/s attack would cause this feature to be removed, if it has any remaining Torpedoes, the attacking opponent may remove an additional Feature and any Battalions assigned to it from this Dropsite.

rules.name: Ark Lander
rules.description:
When this feature is deployed to a Dropsite, 4 friendly Battalions are automatically deployed to that Dropsite.
While Activating Dropsites (during 7.5 Activating Dropsites), if you have more Battalions on this feature than any opponent, you count as controlling the Dropsite this Feature is deployed to. If multiple players count as controlling the same Dropsite this way, this effect is ignored.

rules.name: Scanner Dome
rules.description:
When you assign any weapons to an enemy Ship/Group within 6" of this Dropsite, improve the Lock of those weapons by 1.
When you attack an enemy Descent Ship in Atmosphere within 6" of this Dropsite, instead of the usual penalties for attacking a City or a Descent Ship in Atmosphere (see paragraph 4 of 3.1.2 Atmosphere) that attack always hits on a 5+ and can never cause a critical (instead of a 6+).

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: At the start of the Repair step of the End Phase, remove all Crippling effects from a friendly Group.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: When a friendly Ship of M, H, or C tonnage is destroyed by damage from an opponent's attack (including any Crippling or Explosion Effects), it remains in play until the start of the End Phase. At the start of the End Phase, roll for explosion and remove that Ship from play. That Ship counts as destroyed.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: When you would Roll for Crippling Effects for a friendly Ship (for any reason), roll 1D6 instead of 2D6 for that Ship's Crippling Effect. Count a result of a 1 as a result of a 2.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: When you attack with Fire Ships, one of those attacking Wings gains Corruptor-2 for that attack.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: When you move a Group through Scenery or move/place a Wing of Assets through Scenery, that Group/Wing ignores the effects of that Scenery piece until the end of the movement.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: At the end of the Activation Phase, before activating Dropsites, pick one Dropsite controlled by an enemy player within 6" of a friendly Group. That Dropsite takes D3+1 Core Hits. After rolling, you may spend an additional 1AP to re-roll the D3 and treat this ability as an attack for the purposes of removing a feature.
